description: This Java source file defines a custom exception class `GatewayServiceTooManyRequestsException` used to represent HTTP 429 Too Many Requests errors within the Eclipse Ditto framework. It extends `DittoRuntimeException` and provides static factory methods, a builder, and relevant metadata for handling rate-limiting responses.

classes.name: GatewayServiceTooManyRequestsException
classes.description: A custom exception indicating that the Gateway service has responded with a 'Too Many Requests' (HTTP 429) status, used for rate limiting scenarios within the Eclipse Ditto framework.

classes.description: A thread-unsafe mutable builder class providing a fluent API to construct instances of `GatewayServiceTooManyRequestsException`.
